parameters.description: Accepts a canonical lead (section 5.5) plus lead_id from P1-01. Returns the routed qualification decision and state.

nodes.name: OpenAI Chat Model
nodes.notes: Bind an OpenAI-compatible credential after import. Swap to Groq/Ollama by changing the model node; the chain stays the same.

value.draft_text: ={{ JSON.stringify({ idempotency_key: $('Prepare AI Input').item.json.idempotency_key, intent: $('Confidence & Schema Gate').item.json.ai_intent, intent_confidence: $('Confidence & Schema Gate').item.json.intent_confidence }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const r = $('Route Lead').item.json;
return [{ json: {
  correlation_id: r.correlation_id,
  idempotency_key: r.idempotency_key,
  lead_id: r.lead_id,
  email: r.email,
  name: r.name,
  company: r.company,
  source: r.source,
  route: r.route,
  qualification_status: r.route,
  score: r.score,
  temperature: r.temperature,
  intent: r.intent,
  intent_confidence: r.intent_confidence,
  extracted_signals: r.extracted_signals,
  summary: r.summary,
  owner_id: r.owner_id,
  notification_channel: r.notification_channel,
  calendar_link: r.calendar_link,
  follow_up_at: r.follow_up_at,
  deal_eligible: r.deal_eligible,
  crm_sync_status: r.deal_eligible ? 'pending' : 'not_applicable',
  deal_created: false
}}];
